title: oxypetalum insigne var. glabrum
intro: Oxypetalum insigne var. glabrum, commonly known as "Night-Blooming Cereus," is a plant species belonging to the Apocynaceae family, native to Mexico. The plant has been reported to possess various health benefits, including its potential to reduce inflammation, improve sleep quality, and exhibit antioxidant properties. While the plant's properties are promising, more studies are necessary to fully understand its therapeutic potential and bioactive constituents.
